title: Measures to Prevent World Economic Forum’s Special Annual Meeting In Singapore from Becoming Super Spreader Event
what_it_is: Measures to Prevent World Economic Forum’s Special Annual Meeting In Singapore from Becoming Super Spreader Event

sections.label: COVID-19 measures for event attendees
sections.summary: Rigorous testing, safe management measures, TraceTogether use and physical segregation will be implemented for event attendees, with MOH assessing the situation and adjusting measures.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To actively detect any cases of COVID-19, we will implement rigorous testing arrangements for local and foreign event attendees, in lieu of them serving Stay-Home Notices.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We will also implement safe management measures such as mask-wearing, safe distancing and mandating the use of TraceTogether technology to minimise the risk of transmission and to facilitate the identification of close contacts for isolation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In addition, a physical segregation of event attendees from the local community will reduce the risk of infections spreading from event attendees to the local community at large, and vice versa.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Over the next few months leading up to the Special Annual Meeting, MOH will continue to assess the COVID-19 situation locally and globally, and adjust the public health measures for the event as necessary.

sections.label: Protocols for COVID-19 case at event
sections.summary: If a COVID-19 case occurs at the WEF Special Annual Meeting, prevailing measures and protocols for contact tracing, isolation and follow-up will be followed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: If there is indeed a case of COVID-19 at the WEF Special Annual Meeting, the prevailing measures that we have for a COVID-19 case at any of the events that we are organising, will be in place.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: All the various measures as well as the regulations around contact tracing, isolation and subsequent follow-up will be followed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The protocols are being put in place and are being operationalised already, because we are already hosting and organising events.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: This will be at a larger scale and it will involve a wider group of delegates and attendees but the fundamentals of our approach will be the same.
